question: Data set A has a variance of 2. Data set B is obtained by adding 5 to every value in data set A. Comparing the two data sets, ( )
solution: Adding 5 to every value also increases the mean by 5. Each value's difference from the mean remains unchanged, so the variance remains unchanged and the consistency is the same.
